title: Deeper/broader R24 TABLE merge projection and suppression-field contract
mode: Primary-source web review plus local source/test audit; plan and receipt update only
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Reconcile ODA's R24 TABLECONTENT merged-range and TABLESTYLE layouts with Autodesk's DXF TABLE group-code context.
Audit whether the current AC1024+ DWG parser projects canonical merged ranges into the cell fields required by the DXF writer.
Reassess ACadRust issue #130 and avoid treating same-codec reports or related CADCraft code as independent format evidence.
Add an implementation-ready bounded fast slice under existing PAR-126/7G.3d without promoting R24 TABLESTYLE suppression semantics.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source review and local source/test audit; research receipt and plan edited
method.limitations: The ACadRust issue's reproducer uses the same codec for its DWG write/read path and remains an open peer report asking for retest. ODA documents R24 TABLESTYLE prefix values as unknown; no producer-authored toggle sample was used. Local generated vectors establish only the tested local parser/writer behavior, not producer interoperability, native table rendering, or editable semantics. The shared worktree is broadly dirty; only the plan and this receipt were edited, with no staging or commit.

sources.observed: TABLECONTENT carries a count followed by top-row, left-column, bottom-row, right-column merged-range coordinates. R24 DWG embeds TABLECONTENT in the TABLE entity, while DXF including R24 uses a separate TABLECONTENT object. The pre-R24 TABLESTYLE section lists title/header suppression fields separately; the R24 TABLESTYLE prefix instead labels its leading RC, BL, BL and hard-owner handle fields unknown.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Authoritative format reference for documented field order; the unknown R24 TABLESTYLE values do not identify suppression semantics.

sources.observed: The ACAD_TABLE entity uses per-cell groups 173, 175 and 176 for merge state and dimensions; groups 280 and 281 are described as title/header suppression overrides at the TABLE entity level.
sources.evidenceCeiling: DXF entity group-code reference; identical group numbers in a different object/version context do not map unknown R24 DWG TABLESTYLE fields.

sources.project: ACadRust issue #130 and related CADCraft/OpenCADStudio route
sources.observed: The issue reports that its AC1024+ DWG reader retains canonical merged ranges but leaves per-cell spans at defaults, while its DXF writer serializes from per-cell fields. It separately proposes syncing style flags and DXF suppression booleans. The issue remains open and asks for a retest of candidate commits. CADCraft/OpenCADStudio depend on the ACadRust lineage.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer test-design lead only: the published reproducer writes and reads through the same codec, candidate commits are not independent producer/consumer validation, and related downstream code is not an independent parser vote.

localCrosswalk.observed: parseTableContent() retains m_mergedRanges. The AC1024+ DRW_Table::parseDwg() path commits the typed content but does not set cell m_isMerged/m_mergedWidth/m_mergedHeight from those ranges. dxfRW::writeTable() requires merged-cell count/range agreement and serializes per-cell values as 173/175/176, so the typed table is refused at writer preflight. Existing tests separately cover an AC1024 no-merge vector and manually populated ASCII/Binary merge spans; they do not cover parser-to-writer projection.
localCrosswalk.disposition: Add a bounded range projector before semantic publication. Reuse the existing AC1024 object-vector and ASCII/Binary adapter owners, assert emitted group codes before readback, and preserve raw/fallback behavior for invalid ranges. Do not weaken strict writer preflight.

localCrosswalk.observed: The AC1024+ DRW_TableStyle parser consumes the prefix class byte, name, two bit-long values and a handle into ignored locals; it does not map these values to suppression booleans. Normal reader dispatch has a raw-object retention route, but that is not a typed DXF semantic projection.
localCrosswalk.disposition: Keep R24 suppression values raw/unresolved. Do not map unknown values to m_flags or title/header booleans without an authoritative field map or producer-authored one-property-at-a-time toggle evidence.

assessment.planEffect: Confirms a local AC1024+ canonical-range-to-cell-span projection gap and assigns a small independent fast slice. Corrects the active #130 crosswalk: retain merge projection as a peer lead, remove unsupported R24 TABLESTYLE suppression-bit mapping from the implementation checklist, and keep unknown R24 style values unresolved.
